alt: Real ChatGPT /memorygame execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /memorygame Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive memory game with three concept-definition pairs: training, inference and context. Include card flipping, match feedback and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Flip card 1 and read its concept or definition.
Flip card 2 and read its concept or definition.
Turn the unmatched pair back over before the next attempt.
Flip card 3 and compare it with the cards already seen.
Flip card 4 and compare it with the cards already seen.
Turn the second unmatched pair back over.
Return to the Context card remembered from the first attempt.
Match it with the context definition remembered in card 4.
Flip card 5 to search for the next known pair.
Match the training definition in card 5 with the Training concept in card 3.
Reveal the final unknown card and identify its concept.
Match Inference with the definition remembered in card 1.
Inspect the completed three-pair result and attempt counter.
Restart the memory game with a fresh hidden board.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
